issues.message: The step omits the catalog-required grouping of tasks by status. Fix: The websiteResponse must say the website shows the project's name, description, due date and client together with its tasks grouped by status, with overdue tasks standing out.

The step omits the catalog-required links from each row to its project and client. Fix: The websiteResponse must say the website shows all projects with their name, client name, due date and open task count and that each row links to its project and client.
